subject: Finalizing VIP lounge check-in flow & shipping manifest for CloudConf
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan@cloudconf.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: VIP lounge footprint & check-in questions

Hi Naomi / Marissa —

Quick note as we lock the exhibit floor: the CloudConf VIP program is asking for a small dedicated check-in + hospitality area adjacent to Redwood’s island. We have limited power and a 10x12 footprint margin to work with. A couple of items we need from you by EOD Wednesday so we can finalize the hall plan: 

- Confirm whether you need a staffed check-in table (yes/no) and how many headcount for peak times (we’re estimating 200 VIP arrivals between 9:00–11:30am on day 2).
- Any AV needs for the lounge (e.g., iPad kiosks, one monitor, charging station).
- Shipping preferred cut-off and label format (we’ll want the manifest 72 hours pre-show).

Copying Sienna from LogisticsCo who will be your freight lead. I’ve tentatively held the 10x12 zone next to aisle B4 for Redwood. Let me know if that footprint is acceptable.

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Brooks
Senior Events Manager — CloudConf

From: naomi.feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@cloudconf.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VIP lounge footprint & check-in questions

Thanks Evan — this is the right time to lock things down. Short answers below and a few asks for the logistics team.

- Staffed check-in: Yes. We plan 2 people at peak and 1 floater for the 9:00–12:00 window.
- AV: iPad kiosks (2) for badge scanning + one 32" monitor for itinerary display. We also want a small phone/tablet charging hub (6-port PD).
- Shipping cut-off: Redwood prefers manifest 72 hours pre-show; our carrier wants pallet-level SKUs and a receiver contact. Sienna, I’ll attach our internal shipping template and the preferred label logic.

Marissa — can you review the attached 10x12 layout (vip_lounge_floorplan_v3.pdf) and confirm the table placement + power drop?

Tessa — can you own the materials pick list (brochures, VIP lanyards, acrylic sign holders) and send the final collateral counts by Wednesday morning? I’m putting a small buffer of extras in the manifest but we should be tight on weight.

Evan — the 10x12 next to aisle B4 works for us provided we get one 20A power drop on the short wall and a carpet patch.

Attaching: vip_lounge_floorplan_v3.pdf (latest layout)

Cheers,
Naomi
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: naomi.feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Evan Brooks <evan@cloudconf.com>
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, Sienna Wu <sienna@logisticsco.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VIP lounge footprint & check-in questions

Hi all — reviewed the 10x12. A few practical notes and a small revision attached (vip_checkin_layout.png):

- Table placement: move check-in table to the long side to create a 3ft queuing lane; that keeps the monitor visible to arrivals.
- Power: we need two receptacles — one 20A for the monitor/kiosk and one regular 15A split for chargers (we can run a power strip and label circuits).
- Back-of-house access: suggest a 2ft gap behind the table for staff pass staging; won’t fit within the strict 10x12 unless we push the island boundary by 6 inches — Evan, is that tolerable?
- Collateral: Tessa, I made a tentative pack (see comments in the image) — 150 brochures, 250 VIP lanyards, 40 acrylic itinerary holders, and 1 demo tablet.

Attaching: vip_checkin_layout.png (annotated)

If we can agree on the small boundary exception, I’ll mark the floorplan as final and pass to Sienna for manifest prep. Otherwise we’ll keep as-is and we’ll have to stage some collateral in the crate for staff to fetch.

—Marissa
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Sienna Wu <sienna@logisticsco.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan@cloudconf.com>, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood shipping manifest and pickup window

Hi team — thanks for the layout update. Attached is the initial shipping manifest in XLSX (shipping_manifest_CloudConf_Redwood.xlsx). A few notes: 

- Freight arrival window at the show dock is Tue 2028-07-16 08:00–12:00. If you need a later delivery we’ll need rebooking fees.
- Manifest expects palletized crates; please flag any loose/fragile items (e.g., acrylic holders).
- Label format: please include: Company / Exhibit Name / Booth ID / Contact Name / Cell. I’ve left a sample filled row for Redwood.
- Insurance & waiver: the venue requires a signed waiver for unattended materials. I can send a DocuSign but we usually do that after final manifest confirmation.

Let me know if the 6" boundary adjustment is approved — I can note it on the dock plan.

Best,
Sienna Wu
Senior Logistics Coordinator — LogisticsCo
Attachment: shipping_manifest_CloudConf_Redwood.xlsx

From: naomi.feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com, Sienna Wu <sienna@logisticsco.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan@cloudconf.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2028 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VIP lounge footprint & check-in questions — final confirmation

Thanks everyone — final confirmations below so we have a single source of truth before labels go to pick/pack: 

1) Footprint: approved — CloudConf okayed the 6" push on the island boundary. Floorplan v3 now final. (Marissa: please update doc title to v3-final.)
2) Staffing: 2 at check-in, 1 floater (9:00–12:00 day 2). Marissa to send shift names by Monday.
3) AV: 2 iPad kiosks, 32" monitor, 6-port PD charging hub — Sienna to reserve a 20A drop and a 15A split.
4) Collateral counts (confirmed): 150 brochures, 250 VIP lanyards, 40 acrylic holders, 1 demo tablet. Tessa — please confirm pack weights by Sunday so Sienna can finalize pallets.
5) Shipping: Sienna, go ahead and lock the Tue 2028-07-16 08:00–12:00 pickup. We will send pallet labels in the requested format; I’ll upload the filled manifest to the Drive folder now.
6) Waiver/insurance: Naomi to sign DocuSign once manifest is final.

Next steps (owners):
- Marissa: update floorplan filename and email v3-final back to Sienna (owner).
- Tessa: pack weight estimates by Sunday EOD.
- Sienna: finalize manifest and send DocuSign link.
- Naomi: sign waiver once DocuSign is delivered.

Thanks — we’re green here.

Naomi
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
